def transform(grid):
    """Lines of the second-most-common color divide the grid; markers sit on
    line intersections. Keep a marker only if a same-colored marker sits on
    the previous line row above and the next line column to its right
    (i.e. drop top edges and right edges of each marker rectangle). Output is
    the bounding box of kept markers sampled at line intersections, with
    non-kept cells as the fill (most common) color."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    flat = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    fill = flat.most_common(1)[0][0]
    base = flat.most_common(2)[1][0]
    line_rows = [i for i in range(h) if Counter(grid[i]).most_common(1)[0][0] == base]
    line_cols = [j for j in range(w) if Counter(grid[i][j] for i in range(h)).most_common(1)[0][0] == base]

        if (ri > 0 and grid[line_rows[ri - 1]][c] == v

    if not kept:

    rs = [r for r, _ in kept]; cs = [c for _, c in kept]
    rows_sel = [r for r in line_rows if min(rs) <= r <= max(rs)]
    cols_sel = [c for c in line_cols if min(cs) <= c <= max(cs)]
    out = [[fill] * len(cols_sel) for _ in rows_sel]
    for (r, c) in kept:
